reader.requirement: At 85 a declarative is invoked only for a qualifying condition raised by a statement of the separately compiled program that holds it: a CALLed separately compiled program never reaches its caller's declaratives (nor the reverse), a contained program reaches a container's declarative only when it is USE GLOBAL (X.5.5.4 GR1), and with none qualifying no declarative runs.

edition-consulted.switches: Format 3/4 USE (2002 introductions) and the optional AFTER / PROCEDURE words (2002); at 85 both words are required and F3/F4 refused
DialectLevel >= 2002 adds the SORT GR17 exit filter around the declarative's run; 1985 takes the plain try/finally, which does not touch selection
nothing: the file-name tier then open-mode tier are documented edition-invariant (kb/Work PB344)

reader.edition-search: grepped DialectBehavior, DialectLevel, Edition., CobolVersion across DispatchEmitter, EcEmitter, ProgramEmitter, UseTierEmitter and the I-O verb emitters; VisitUseStatement in Validation
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: the selection (own program, then GLOBAL containers outward, never across a CALL) is one path at every edition
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witnesses show each program's own declarative; they do not show the refusal half (a callee or a contained program with NO declarative, under a caller USE ON INPUT), which the probes add

probes.printed: MAIN DECL 35 / MAIN OPEN 35 / SUB OPEN 35 / MAIN DECL 35 / NEST OPEN 35 / MAIN END

probes.printed: statement after each failed OPEN (status 35) executes
probes.expected: with no qualifying declarative none runs and execution continues

reader.notes: Selection is per emitted program class: __IoCheck walks the local tiers, then __outer.__RunGlobalUse only when a container holds USE GLOBAL; a CALL crosses into another class with its own __IoCheck, so the caller's declaratives are unreachable. The 1985 arm of EmitRunUseBody differs from the latest (no SORT GR17 filter) but that does not affect which declarative is selected.

refuter.evidence: ext.cob (ext-001): EXTERNAL relative FX shared by EXTMAIN (USE ON FX) and separately compiled EXTSUB (no decl) / EXTSUB2 (own USE ON INPUT): main READ 47 -> MAIN DECL only; EXTSUB READ 47 and OPEN 35 -> no declarative (caller's not reached); EXTSUB2 OPEN 35 -> SUB2 DECL only; main again -> MAIN DECL only. nest3.cob (nest3-001): MID's own INPUT declarative chosen over OUTER's GLOBAL INPUT (one only); inner program with no decl, MID GLOBAL is OUTPUT only, MID INPUT non-GLOBAL skipped, OUTER GLOBAL INPUT reached for FH (X.5.5.4 GR1 a-c). useA/useD.cob: 'USE AFTER ERROR ON INPUT' and 'USE STANDARD ERROR ...' refused at 85 (COBOL0900), useC 'USE AFTER EXCEPTION CONDITION EC-I-O' refused (COBOL0877/0878), useB 'USE AFTER EXCEPTION PROCEDURE INPUT' (ON omitted) admitted and runs. cite.py: OK §1985:VIII.4.8.4 GR1 the text is in GR1; OK §1985:X.5.5.4 GR1 the text is in GR1; OK §1985:X.5.5.4 GR1b the text is in GR1b.
